name: Ambient Light out of Bounds
hint: This comparison uses an ambient-light value outside the sensor's supported range, so the condition cannot represent a reliable reading and robot behaviour may become unpredictable.
instruction: Keep Codey ambient-light values between 0 and 100 and mBot values between 0 and 1020; validate or clamp thresholds before comparing them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB ambient light intensity :: sensing) > (150)> then
say [Invalid light reading]
end
